build_cluster_gaussian_blobs: build a clustering example using make_blobs to generate isotropic gaussian blobs and cluster them with KMeans
test_kmeans_anisotropic: test KMeans clustering on anisotropically distributed blobs with a linear transformation
review_kmeans_unequal_variance: review KMeans behavior on clusters with unequal variance using make_blobs with varying cluster_std
build_kmeans_uneven_sized: build a KMeans clustering example with unevenly sized blobs and increase n_init to avoid local minima
build_gaussian_mixture_clusters: build a GaussianMixture clustering example to handle anisotropic and unequal variance blobs
